mapper.select: SELECT a.`name`, count(*) total FROM t_tag a LEFT JOIN t_template b ON a.entity_id = b.id LEFT JOIN t_repo d ON b.repo_id = d.id WHERE d.id = #{repoId} GROUP by a.`name`
SELECT a.question_type, COUNT(*) total FROM t_template a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 and a.repo_id = #{repoId} GROUP BY a.question_type
